## Appearance

Rachel Lynde is a fat woman with a distinct movement, described as someone who always waddles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

Rachel Lynde is a kind, hardworking, and capable woman who is known for her observant nature and deep involvement as an active worker in her church. Exceptionally managing, she handles her own affairs alongside those of others, though her penchant for curiosity means few occurrences in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) escape her notice. She prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor, offering advice that can be aggressive or scorching despite her good heart and willingness to admit her own mistakes. A skilled sewer and dedicated, tender nurse, she holds a pessimistic outlook on life's disappointments yet remains firmly devoted to her home, preferring to live anywhere in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) over leaving it.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde was a long-time resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who had lived as [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's neighbor for forty-five years without a quarrel. Intrigued when [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dressed up and drove away, she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and was thoroughly shocked to learn the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) were adopting an orphan boy. When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived instead, Mrs. Rachel visited and bluntly criticized her appearance, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to explode at her; however, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a dramatic apology at her home, Mrs. Rachel readily forgiven her. Over time, she assisted the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) household, such as when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) enlisted her help to select and sew a modern dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). She monitored local affairs closely, cautioning [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) against starting a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and later discovering that the local hall had been painted bright blue due to a paint mix-up. After her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) passed away, Mrs. Rachel accepted Marilla's invitation to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), an arrangement that freed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave teaching and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Quotes

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "And every one of them said they liked you splendid, Anne, except Anthony Pye. I must admit he didn’t. He said you ‘weren’t any good, just like all girl teachers.’ There’s the Pye leaven for you. But never mind."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde's relationship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) had a rocky start when Rachel harshly criticized Anne's physical appearance, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to respond with an explosive insult. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a thorough, dramatic apology, Mrs. Lynde readily forgave her and offered comforting words about her hair. Over time, their dynamic softened into a lasting acquaintance, with Rachel offering sensible advice on how to manage Anne's fiery spirit.

- Friend of — forgiven acquaintance  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P46](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0046), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P25](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0025)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are close neighbors and trusted friends who frequently visit one another to swap local news, gossip, and personal advice. Though Rachel was initially shocked and skeptical when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt an orphan, their close bond endured as they regularly conferred on managing household matters. Their solidarity also extends to practical comradeship, such as traveling together to attend political mass meetings in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown).

- Comrade of — traveling together to a political mass meeting in Charlottetown  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001)</sub>
- Friend of — neighbors who consult each other for advice  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P40](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0040), +3 more</sub>
